definitionZh: 规则破解 CSS 的短手属性将断列规则的行为设置为行和列间间隙交叉的区段,将列规则破解和行规则破解设定为相同值.
sourceDefinition: The rule-break CSS shorthand property sets the behavior for breaking column and row rules into segments where rows and column gaps intersect, setting column-rule-break and row-rule-break to the same value.

sourceEvidence.sourceDefinition: The rule-break CSS shorthand property sets the behavior for breaking column and row rules into segments where rows and column gaps intersect, setting column-rule-break and row-rule-break to the same value.
